summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the status of its ongoing share buyback program for the period from July 6 to July 10, 2026, repurchasing 96,195 shares at an average price of EUR 60.27 per share for about EUR 5.8 million. The buyback, authorized in May 2024, is for employee share plans. No special situation event is present.
